Privacy Policy for Asura

Effective Date: 11/17/2024

1. Information We Collect

For the bot, Asura collects the following information:

  • Guild IDs (Server Identifiers)
  • User IDs

The website also uses PostHog analytics to collect usage data such as page paths. Query parameters are not included in tracked page URLs.

2. How We Use the Information

The collected information is used solely to provide the intended functionality of Asura, such as managing server settings or tracking user interactions within the bot.

3. Data Sharing

We use PostHog, a third-party analytics provider, to process website analytics. We do not sell or distribute collected information unless required by law.

4. Data Retention

Guild IDs and user IDs are retained as long as necessary to support the bot's functionality. If a guild removes the bot, its associated data will be deleted promptly.

5. User Rights

If you have concerns about the data stored, you may contact us to request its deletion or to gain insight into how it is used.

6. Changes to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Users will be notified of significant changes, and continued use of the bot constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

7. Contact Us

For questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at the support server.
